# Wichita State University

> > Wichita State University's School of Music and School of Performing Arts offer comprehensive programs in music education, performance, theatre, and dance in Wichita, Kansas.

WSU's fine arts programs feature renowned faculty and alumni including opera stars Samuel Ramey and Joyce DiDonato. The School of Music provides degree pathways in commercial music, music education, and performance with world-class facilities including Wiedemann Recital Hall and the Great Marcussen Organ.

## Academic Programs and Pathways

- [Music Pathways](https://wichita.edu/academics/fine_arts/music/musicpathways.php): Music degree options including commercial music and industry studies
- [School of Performing Arts](https://wichita.edu/academics/fine_arts/spa/index-PADAY.php): WSU School of Performing Arts programs in theatre, dance, and design
- [Opera](https://wichita.edu/academics/fine_arts/music/ensembleopera.php): WSU Opera Theater program featuring alumni Samuel Ramey and Joyce DiDonato
- [Keyboard Area](https://wichita.edu/academics/fine_arts/music/areakeyboard.php): Piano and organ programs with audition requirements and pedagogy focus

## Prospective Students and Admissions

- [Request Information](https://wichita.edu/academics/fine_arts/music/form_inforequest.php): Inquiry form for prospective music students and degree programs
- [Undergraduate Strings Auditions](https://wichita.edu/academics/fine_arts/music/strings_stringundergradauditions.php): Audition requirements for undergraduate strings programs at WSU
- [High School Honor Band](https://wichita.edu/academics/fine_arts/music/band_honorband.php): WSU High School Honor Band festival and audition program
- [All-State WPJ Workshop](https://wichita.edu/academics/fine_arts/music/band_allstateday.php): All-State workshop for music major preview and audition preparation

## Facilities and Performance Venues

- [Wiedemann Recital Hall](https://wichita.edu/academics/fine_arts/boxoffice/Wiedemann.php): Wiedemann Hall concert venue featuring the Great Marcussen Organ

## Student Resources and Support

- [Health and Safety](https://wichita.edu/academics/fine_arts/music/health_safety.php): Musician wellness resources and injury prevention for music students
- [Accompanist Guild Policy](https://wichita.edu/academics/fine_arts/music/accompanist_guild_policy.php): Fee schedule and policies for music accompaniment services
